This season, Stephen Curry announced that for the first time in his career, he was no longer tied to a specific athletic wear brand partner. What followed was a history-making run of kicks, game after game. Now, more than 70 of those pairs are headed to auction at #SothebysNewYork, with proceeds benefitting the work of @EatLearnPlay.“I’ve always believed that every pair of sneakers tells a story. This collection really captures a unique chapter for me during my sneaker free agency this season. From the tunnel walks to the on-court warm-ups to the games across the country, I was excited to spend this time shining a light on players over the years who have left their mark on the sneaker game.” — Stephen CurryRegister now for ‘The Stephen Curry Collection: My Sneaker Free Agency’, open for bidding from 13-28 April, on Sothebys.com. #LinkInBio #CoFounder

@stephencurry30 and @ayeshacurry join us on @imopodcasts this week! From being childhood sweethearts to titans in their respective industries, we dove into the early years of their relationship, why they’ve always put family first, and how they learned that prioritizing themselves is actually the best thing you can do for those you love. Their admiration for each other is truly something to behold. Watch now on YouTube, or listen wherever you get your podcasts.

Taking the Underrated Golf Tour global has always been about creating more opportunity.Year 3 in Europe is here.With the support of @united, we’re continuing to connect athletes and expand the game across continents.This year at The Belfry, four juniors will earn their way to Curry Cup. Bethpage will have that European presence.Let’s get to work.

Happy birthday to the one that makes this whole thing work! This past year has been one of my favorites. The determination to go after what you want. The grind and work behind the scenes. Deeply honored to be recognized with the Muhammad Ali Sports Humanitarian Award at the ESPYS. Mr. Ali’s legacy taught us that our platform is only as valuable as the lives we impact off the court. It’s a standard Ayesha and I always hold close in everything we build with @eatlearnplay.  This award represents the collective heart of our entire team, our partners, and the beautiful Oakland community. We share this with everyone who continues to show up for our kids and families. We’ve come a long way, but there’s still so much more to do. Grateful for the support. Let's keep pushing forward.

ACC 2026 is done! The vibes were high and a lot of amazing memories made. Pops takes home the Curry Belt for the 2nd time.
